doc: Deferred negatives (debt D7 -- docs/verdict_policy.md Section 6). Positive cases whose verdict guard IS expect-flippable (it compares against an operator-supplied expected value) but which carry no sound NEG_ROW yet, each with an explicit reason. Unlike the conformant-absence registry (DUT-behaviour guards that no --expect can fault), these can and should eventually get a sound expect-flip negative or a parameterisation; the reason records why they don't yet (Linux deviation makes the positive itself fail, the guard checks a compiled constant that must be lifted to applyExpectedDefaults, etc.). Tracked here so the exhaustiveness audit accounts for them rather than letting them fall through. Prefer fixing over deferring.

cases.IPv4_REASSEMBLY_11: needs-sound-negative: Linux ipfrag_time deviation makes the positive itself land on fail_timeout (no Echo Reply), so an echo_id-flip negative carries zero diagnostic variance
cases.IPv4_REASSEMBLY_13: needs-sound-negative: overlapping-fragment reassembly is dropped post-CVE-2018-5391 on Linux, so the positive does not reassemble; deferred with REASSEMBLY_11
cases.ICMPv4_TYPE_08: needs-parameterise: echo payload is checked against a compiled constant (kIcmpv4EchoPayloadType08); lift to applyExpectedDefaults + expected.payload like the ETS echoes, then add a sound payload-flip row
cases.ICMPv4_TYPE_09: needs-verification: echo_id-flip negative is structurally sound (twin of the CI-verified TYPE_12) but its own row is unverified on the wire; promote to a SOUND_ROW after a smoke run shows it lands on fail:echo_id_mismatch (not skip)
cases.DHCPv4_CLIENT_ALLOCATING_10: template-artifact: a count-only liveness case (2 RENEWING REQUESTs) whose sole fail final (unreachable_pass_expr_always_true) is dead under the dhcpv4_renewing_retx_field binding pass_expr=true (fail cond is !(pass_expr) = false); no reachable fail to validate. Fix is to give the template a no-fail liveness variant, then re-register as a liveness guard
